description: Source code for a Zephyr-based video software generator driver implementing buffer management, format setting, stream control, and color bar pattern generation.

methods.name: video_sw_generator_set_fmt
methods.description: Sets the video format for the generator device.

methods.name: video_sw_generator_get_fmt
methods.description: Retrieves the current video format of the generator device.

methods.name: video_sw_generator_stream_start
methods.description: Starts the video stream by scheduling buffer work.

methods.name: video_sw_generator_stream_stop
methods.description: Stops the video stream by canceling scheduled buffer work.

methods.name: __fill_buffer_colorbar
methods.description: Fills a video buffer with a color bar pattern.

methods.name: __buffer_work
methods.description: Periodic work function to generate and enqueue video buffers.

methods.name: video_sw_generator_enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a video buffer into the input FIFO.

methods.name: video_sw_generator_dequeue
methods.description: Dequeues a video buffer from the output FIFO.

methods.name: video_sw_generator_flush
methods.description: Flushes buffers, optionally canceling ongoing operations.

methods.name: video_sw_generator_set_signal
methods.description: Sets a poll signal for buffer completion notification.

methods.name: video_sw_generator_set_ctrl
methods.description: Sets control parameters such as vertical flip.
